newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 2.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 2.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended 49.54 points higher at 7,722.33 as key manufacturing data eased concerns about a near-term rise in interest rates.
* Indonesia's consumer price index for June was likely to show a month-on-month fall of 0.16-0.18 percent, compared with a rise of 0.19 percent in May, government officials said on Tuesday.
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta Composite Index closed up 7.06 points, or 0.97 percent, at 731.62 points on active buying of blue chips and secondaries, brokers said.

* The rupiah nose-dived to a low of 2,445.0 against the dollar in early trade on Wednesday following the flotation of the Thai baht, but it recovered very quickly to its opening level around 2,433.0/35.0.
* Pharmaceutical firm Tempo Scan on a report in Bisnis Indonesia daily that a founding shareholder had sold 20 million shares, or a 13 percent stake, through a private placement.
* Medium-sized Bank Bahari following its debut on Tuesday. The bank listed 262 million shares on the Jakarta exchange.

* Property firm PT Dharmala Intiland on a news report on Tuesday that it had an operational cooperation pact with Putra Surya Perkasa to market Dharmala Intiland property projects. The Bisnis Indonesia daily quoted a Dharmala executive as saying the companies had no plans for a merger.
* Property firm Bakrieland on continued market talk that it would be involved in the construction of a mass rapid transportation project.

* PT Asiana Multikreasi following a report in the Harian Ekonomi Neraca newspaper on Tuesday that it planned to propose a 10-for-10 rights issue attached with three warrants at a price of 500 rupiah per share.
* Tamara Bank on reports that it had tied up with China Trust Commercial Bank of Taiwan and planned to launch a joint venture bank in Jakarta on July 23.
